chunks: And two youths entered the prison with him. One of them said: 'I see myself pressing wine.' And the other said: 'I see myself carrying bread upon my head, from which birds eat.' Tell us its interpretation; indeed, we see you as one of the righteous.'
ai.seo_question: What did the two prisoners dream of, and how did Joseph interpret it?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the divine preparation of Prophet Joseph (AS) through his imprisonment, where his recognized piety ('al-husn') leads to his role as a dream interpreter. In Shia exegesis, this period is often viewed as a crucial stage of spiritual refinement and political isolation before his eventual rise to power in Egypt.
